statements.statement: Motion to approve the FY20 school budget at this bottom line, a three percent increase budget.
Free cash and stabilization amounts in the town budget follow the town financial policy, so not available to the schools.

warnings.prediction: Level funding of non-personnel lines is essentially a cut and cannot be sustained beyond this year; some lines will need increases.
The budget is tight and enrollment is unknown; the district might come to a fall town meeting to reallocate money for staff.
